nodes.description: Total token supply stored in contract state (uint256 totalSupply_).
Mapping of holder address to token balance; mutated by transfer and transferFrom.
Nested allowance mapping (owner => spender => amount); mutated by approve and transferFrom.
msg.sender used as the implicit caller/owner for transfers, approvals and allowance spend.
Constructor assigning the whole initial supply to the deployer.
transfer(address,uint256): moves tokens from msg.sender to receiver after a balance require.
approve(address,uint256): sets allowed[msg.sender][delegate].
transferFrom(address,address,uint256): spends allowance of owner and moves tokens to buyer.
balanceOf(address): view returning balances[tokenOwner].
allowance(address,address): view returning allowed[owner][delegate].
totalSupply(): view returning totalSupply_.
SafeMath.sub/add balance mutation in transfer and transferFrom, guarded only by require checks.
SafeMath.sub on allowed[owner][msg.sender] in transferFrom, plus the SafeMath.add overflow-checked addition.
transfer receiver address parameter.
transfer numTokens amount parameter.
approve delegate (spender) address parameter.
approve numTokens amount parameter.
allowance owner address parameter.
allowance delegate address parameter.
transferFrom owner address parameter whose allowance is spent.
transferFrom buyer/recipient address parameter.
transferFrom numTokens amount parameter compared against balance and allowance.
Local SafeMath result variable c computed inside add/sub before being written to state.

edges.reason: transfer receiver parameter flows into the recipient balance credit.
transfer numTokens drives the subtraction of msg.sender balance and the require check.
transfer numTokens is the operand of SafeMath.sub/add on balances.
approve delegate address becomes the second key of the allowed mapping.
approve numTokens is written verbatim into allowed[msg.sender][delegate].
allowance owner parameter indexes the allowed mapping.
allowance delegate parameter indexes the allowed mapping.
transferFrom owner parameter is the account whose allowance and balance are consumed.
transferFrom buyer parameter receives the credited tokens.
transferFrom numTokens is checked against balances[owner] and allowed[owner][msg.sender].
transferFrom numTokens is the operand of SafeMath.sub on balances[owner].
transferFrom numTokens is the operand of SafeMath.sub on the allowance mapping entry.
msg.sender determines whose allowance is spendable in transferFrom.
msg.sender is the debited account in transfer.
msg.sender is the owner key set in approve.
msg.sender (deployer) receives the initial supply in the constructor.
totalSupply_ is initialized from the constructor total argument.
balances mapping is written for the deployer in the constructor.
Constructor initialization precedes all later balance arithmetic.
transfer executes the SafeMath balance mutation after its require guard.
transferFrom executes balance subtraction after both require guards.
transferFrom executes allowance subtraction before crediting the buyer.
Result of SafeMath.sub/add is written back into the balances mapping.
Result of SafeMath.sub is written back into the allowed mapping.
Local SafeMath result c holds the intermediate value later stored in state.
Local SafeMath result c carries the intermediate allowance value.

normalization_plan.reason: Receiver parameter only exists to key the recipient balance credit inside transfer.
numTokens is the arithmetic operand consumed by the SafeMath balance mutation in transfer.
Delegate is only used as the spender key of the allowed mapping in approve.
numTokens is directly written into the allowed mapping by approve.
Owner indexes the allowed mapping in the allowance view function.
Delegate indexes the allowed mapping in the allowance view function.
Owner is the account whose balance and allowance are spent in transferFrom.
Buyer only receives the credited tokens in transferFrom.
numTokens is the amount subtracted from the allowance and balance in transferFrom.
The SafeMath intermediate result c is transient and fully replaced by the balance mutation it feeds.
